Https isn't as secure as every one thinks. It's pretty easy to set up a man in the middle attack even for a complete noob all you need us a $90 pineapple.

For one, I trun off my wifi adapters when I leave the house, never connect to open or free WiFi cause once your device connects to it, it will remember it and start sending out probes to see if it's available, this is another Avenue of attack, always connect to a VPN before leaving the house, at least then you are already connected and passing traffic through a tunnel. If there is nothing wrong with a site you use and it uses https, when you try to load it always check that the url still shows https or else you might be the victim of a SSL strip man in the middle attack.

There is a lot you can do, I personally recommend everyone buy a pineapple and play with it. This will give you knowledge and more importantly awareness of the kind of things that can be done, so that you can be more aware.

Edit: oh fake SSL certs is another one, most people just ignore the warning and accept the cert.
